question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the experimental core Claws lifecycle, including persistent managed-workspace provenance, as a core feature rather than defer it to a different extension direction?
rationale: The patch is a new persistent core workflow, not a repair to an established shipped contract; repository vision and prior review context require maintainer intent to decide whether this lifecycle should enter core.

options.title: Pause pending sponsorship
options.body: Keep the stack open but do not merge or dispatch further feature work until an authorized maintainer confirms that the Claws lifecycle belongs in core.

options.title: Sponsor the lifecycle
options.body: Accept the experimental core direction and review the stacked slices in order, requiring exact-head CI and ordinary owner review before merge.

options.title: Decline core scope
options.body: Close or redirect the implementation stack if maintainers decide this lifecycle should not be added to OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Pause pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep the stack open but do not merge or dispatch further feature work until an authorized maintainer confirms that the Claws lifecycle belongs in core.
